text:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning a small announce/changelog rollup tomorrow morning. Need a quick QA pass on: migration guide (Dedicated->Private), SDK snippets (py/js/curl), and a link health sweep after the sidebar reorg. Who can help?

samir: I can do the JS snippets. Noticed the JS streaming example uses `response.on('data')` which is outdated for our streaming client — I'll update to the new async iterator.

rachael: I'll run the link checker across the docs tree and dump 404s. FYI I already saw a few broken anchors in the migration guide.

oliver: Small API note: the generation param `max_tokens` was renamed to `max_new_tokens` in the new runtime. Migration guide needs a callout and a one-line find/replace. I can add that.

docsbot: PR opened: #789-changelog-rollup by maya — includes draft whats-new bullets and relnotes skeleton.

jen: Add a known-issue entry — hosted streaming can truncate on long prefilled prompts under certain chunking patterns. Workaround: reduce prefix size or enable KV-prefix-caching. I'll draft text.

maya: Two blockers to be aware of: (1) several examples depend on streaming behavior that we don't expose in the Dedicated rollout yet; (2) migration steps for Dedicated customers need explicit instructions for pinning model versions and quantization profiles. Samir, can you update samples to include both streaming and non-streaming variants?

samir: Yep. I'll add an async iterator example and a non-streaming fallback. Also planning to add curl examples for quick copy-paste. Question: should function-calling examples be included or do we link to the feature-flag doc? The feature is gated in Dedicated for now.

rachael: Link health: I will include a CSV with broken URLs + suggested redirects. For the anchors, some are because we changed headings from H3->H2. Suggest adding redirect rules in the frontmatter.

oliver: I pushed a small redirect PR for the migration guide anchors — fixes two of the three broken links rachael found. Will mark the third as a longer rename.

maya: Perfect. jen, once samir updates snippets can you stitch in the workaround text into the relnotes? Also we should call out the Dedicated behavior in the whats-new blurb so support gets fewer tickets.

jen: Will do. I'll add a short "Known limitations" bullet and link to the migration section.

samir: Pushed snippet updates to my branch: changed JS streaming to `for await (const chunk of stream)` and added Python example using the sync fallback. Example snippet below for the docs copy:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD")
# non-streaming fallback
resp = client.generate(model="rwdk/fast-2", prompt="Summarize...", max_new_tokens=128)
print(resp.text)
```

maya: Nice. Can you also add the curl example with the new param name so customers searching the docs get the correct key?

samir: Yep — will include both `max_new_tokens` and a short note that older SDKs might still show `max_tokens`.

rachael: CSV incoming in ~10m. Also flagged several markdown links that used absolute paths to /docs/v1/... — those should be updated to /docs/latest/... or use site-relative paths so they survive renames.

oliver: FYI I'm on call tomorrow at 08:00 PT but can review quick PRs before 09:00. If we want to publish, let's target merge by 08:45 PT so deploybot can pick it up in the 09:30 window.

maya: Can everyone aim to have changes in by 08:30 PT? If anything slips, we soft-roll next Tuesday. I'll open a final combine-PR and request reviews from @oliver @samir @rachael.

docsbot: Reminder: deploy window opens 09:30 PT. Please ensure changelog and relnotes are finalized 1 hour prior.

jen: I'll add the known-issue entry and include the workaround steps + short reproducible example. Ping me when snippets are live and I'll link them.

maya: Thanks team. Quick checklist for merge: 1) samir updates snippets (py/js/curl) 2) rachael link CSV + redirections 3) oliver anchor redirect PR merged 4) jen known-issue entry added 5) maya opens final combine PR and requests quick reviews. If all green, publish in tomorrow morning slot.

samir: On it — will tag when done.

rachael: CSV uploaded to the PR comments.

oliver: Reviewed and approved redirect PR.

jen: Known-issue text pushed into relnotes draft.

maya: Merged combined PR at 08:40 PT — thumbs if you see anything wrong. :thumbsup:

samir: Looks good from snippets side.

rachael: Links fixed where possible, redirects in place for the rest.

oliver: All good.

docsbot: Deploy started at 09:32 PT — monitoring logs.

maya: Closing thread — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. If any post-deploy regressions show up, comment here and we'll triage.
